author: TeIq
content: Delivered: EventBus<T> trait + EventEnvelope<T> (with WIRE_VERSION=1 + producer-seq + source) + BusError thiserror. Three backends: memory (always, broadcast-based, 4 unit tests covering round-trip + multi-subscriber + topic isolation + lag-as-typed-error); kafka (bus-kafka feature, rdkafka FutureProducer + StreamConsumer + bincode envelope, compile-test); nats (bus-nats feature, async-nats publish/subscribe + bincode envelope, 2 compile/typed-error tests). Default features include bus-nats. async-trait used for dyn-compat. No anyhow in library surface. No Arc<Mutex<...>> on producer/consumer state. Workspace deps pinned: rdkafka 0.39, async-nats 0.48, bincode 2.
